description: Line items. One row per product on a quote. Prices resolved from the price list, never typed.

columns.name: list_unit_price
columns.note: From the price list, at the tier the quantity earns

columns.name: tier_applied
columns.note: Which volume tier the quantity reached

columns.name: discount_reason
columns.note: REQUIRED where a discount is applied. A discount with no reason is a discount nobody can defend at renewal.

columns.name: extended
columns.note: DERIVED: quantity x net unit price

columns.name: below_floor
columns.note: DERIVED. Should never be yes on a sent quote.
